major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown with Divine Toll about to come up, then spend the window pressing Hammer of Wrath in place of Judgment.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 31884 is the Avenging Wrath cast id, castable per its tooltip but not pressed in the sampled parses because all five ran the Sentinel choice node. Table base cooldown is 120s; Righteous Protector halves it.

major_cooldowns.name: Sentinel
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown as your burst and mitigation window, and get Divine Toll out inside it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 389539 is both the cast id and the self aura in all five sampled parses. Table base cooldown is 120s; Righteous Protector halves it, which matches the roughly 60s cadence in the parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it inside your Avenging Wrath or Sentinel window after dumping Holy Power, so the Judgments it casts are not wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Sacred Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Refresh it as it runs low and apply it before your burst window opens rather than inside it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 432472 is the Holy Armaments cast that arms Sacred Weapon; the self auras log as 432502 and 432616.

major_cooldowns.name: Light's Potential
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it in the opener with your burst window up and again the moment both come back.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Light's Potential is the potion consumed in all five sampled parses; the guide's opener timeline names Tempered Potion (431932) instead.

rule.description: Shield of the Righteous spends banked Holy Power
rule.action: Hold it until you have Holy Power banked, then spend before you cap.
Recast Consecration the moment you step out of the old one.

rule.description: Divine Toll inside your Sentinel window
rule.action: Open Sentinel first, then send Divine Toll inside the window.
Throw Avenger's Shield as soon as Vanguard lights it up.

rule.description: Arm Sacred Weapon before Sentinel, not inside it
rule.action: Refresh Sacred Weapon between burst windows so window GCDs go to damage.
